While /bin/sh is POSIX-standard, if strict avoidance of literal absolute paths in tests is required, resolve `sh` before clearing PATH or pass PATH=\"\" via env utility/command prefix inside the shell.

Existing cross-platform tests in crates/mori/tests/init.rs:129-323 remain intact because both init calls in lines 197-206 share CARGO_BIN_EXE_mori.
